name: Type 59 / Al-Zarrar
origin: China (Norinco), Al-Zarrar upgrade by HIT Pakistan
armament: 100 mm rifled gun (Type 59) or 125 mm smoothbore (Al-Zarrar)
protection: Cast steel dome turret; Al-Zarrar adds ERA. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm damage optics, stowage and tracks; every launcher in the game (PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) penetrates from any arc, frontal hull included at close range.
visual_notes: Chinese T-54A copy: rounded dome cast turret, five large road wheels with a gap between the first and second
Al-Zarrar: ERA blocks on the turret front, new fire control, 125 mm gun with thermal sleeve
Rear external fuel drums, unditching log
